candidate_reports.remark: AWOS station KY19 Mandan.
ASOS station KBIS Bismarck Airport.
Picture from social media of tree branches down. Estimated around 3 in diameter. Time matched with the highest wind gust at KBIS ASOS 3 miles southeast of location.
Mesonet station EW9213 Huff Hills.
Multiple reports across Bismarck of small to medium trees and branches down_ including around the airport and WFO property.
Broadcast media forwarded a picture of a hail stone_ next to a quarter.
Reports a lot of mostly small hail accumulating on the ground. The largest up to nickel size. Hail lasted about 20 minutes beginning around 8 pm central time. No damage reported.
Broadcast media reported multiple ping pong size hail reported in Bowman.
Quarters reported by the State of North Dakota DWR at the bowman airport.
Train spotter reported golf ball size hail and some crop damage from the hail.
[Delayed report] Public photo of golf ball sized hail south of Scranton.
Relayed report of mostly small hail near Buchanan this morning. Time estimated on radar.
Relayed through broadcast media of a large hail stone slightly bigger than 2 inches in diameter approximately 10 miles southeast of Litchville. Time estimated based on radar.
Social media report and photo of golf ball sized hail 10 miles north of Rhame. Time estimated based on radar.
Social media report and video of abundant hail on the ground near Amidon. Largest hail estimated to the size of a quarter. Time estimated based on radar.
Photo relayed through social media.
Hail up to around the size of golf balls. Observer noted hail lasted approximately 35 minutes.
Photo relayed through broadcast media.
Photo relayed through social media. Time estimated from radar.
Photo relayed through social media shows multiple windows broken out on a home and moderate piles of hail next to the home.
Damage photos due to large hail submitted to broadcast media. Includes damage to siding of structure_ large dents on the roof of a camper_ and multiple impacts to truck windshield.
Time estimated from radar.
Trained spotter reports multiple very large hail stones 3 inches or greater. Largest measured hailstone was 3.5 inches. Reports ditch was packed very large hail stones up to 30 minute after the storm
Measured hailstone found 20 minutes after the storm had passed. Found in ditch filled with mostly golf ball and tennis ball size hail. Time estimated from radar.
Social media video of hail estimated up to golf ball size.
10 meter measured wind gust at New Salem 6SE NDAWN.
Photo shared by broadcast media. Hail lasted 17 minutes.
Multiple reports of large hail in and around Lincoln. Largest around tennis ball sized.
Report from mPING: Quarter (1.00 in.).
Photo relayed through social media.
Social media report and photo of baseball sized hail south of Menoken.
Public social media report and photo of near baseball size hail south of Apple Valley.
Mostly pea sized hail with a few nickel to quarter sized mixed in. Hail lasted 16 minutes ending at 1124 pm CDT. Little wind. 0.89 inches of rain.
Photo relayed through social media. Time estimated by radar.
